mailboxes.caption_other: {{count}} addresses · incoming only; mail to each opens tickets in its department

confirm.title: Replace the shared secret?
confirm.body: Providers still using the current secret are refused from the moment you replace it. Update each provider with the new one straight away.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{address}}?
deleteConfirm.body: Mail sent to this address stops opening tickets. Tickets it already opened stay where they are.

address.displayNameHint: Shown to customers as the sender name.
address.departmentHint: Replies to an existing ticket stay in that ticket’s department.

incoming.caption: How Helpdock collects mail sent to this address.

refusal.department-not-found: That department no longer exists. Pick another.

autoReplies.heading: Auto-replies
autoReplies.caption: For the whole brand. Sent from the ticket's department sender, in the contact's language, else the brand's default.
autoReplies.acknowledgmentHint: Sent once when an email opens a new ticket. Carries the ticket reference so the customer's reply threads.

autoReplies.loopBody: Auto-replies carry Auto-Submitted: auto-replied and are never sent to mail marked Auto-Submitted or Precedence: bulk / list, or to noreply@ and mailer-daemon@ senders.

failed.heading: Failed sends
failed.caption: Replies the mail server refused {{attempts}} times. Nothing is retried until you choose.
failed.note: Retry sends the same message with the same Message-ID, so a customer never receives it twice. Discard leaves the reply on the ticket marked Not delivered.

failed.discarded: Discarded. The reply stays on the ticket, marked Not delivered.

appearance.caption: Mode and look. The preview updates as you change them; visitors see them once saved.

chat.label: Chat

helpcenter.label: Help center
helpcenter.hint: Search and browse articles inside the widget. A Contact us link opens the form.

form.label: Contact form
form.hint: No live chat. Visitors leave a message that becomes a ticket.

appearance.contrastPass: White text on it: {{ratio}} : 1, passes. Below 3 : 1 is refused.
appearance.contrastFail: White text on it: {{ratio}} : 1. Below 3 : 1 is refused; choose a darker colour.
appearance.schemeHint: Auto follows the visitor's system setting.

appearance.greetingHint: The greeting is the first message a visitor sees. An empty Arabic greeting falls back to the English one.

preview.heading: Live preview

preview.replies: Usually replies in a few minutes
preview.name: Name

conversation.heading: Conversation
conversation.caption: What visitors see before, during and after a chat.
conversation.prechat: Ask for details before the first message
conversation.prechatHint: An email typed here is not verified. Agents see an Unverified badge, and it never opens the visitor's other conversations.
conversation.fieldsHint: Fields come from Inbox › Custom fields. Answers are saved on the ticket.
conversation.agent: Show the agent's name and photo
conversation.agentHint: When an agent joins, visitors see their first name and avatar.
conversation.unavailableKeep: Keep chat open and say when we reply
conversation.unavailableHint: Outside business hours, or when no agent is online. Hours are set in Inbox › Business hours.
conversation.transcriptHint: When the chat ends, visitors can have it sent to the address they typed. The email holds this conversation only, with no link back into it.

policy.heading: What visitors can send
policy.caption: Each kind on or off, with a size cap and the file types allowed. Admins and Team Leaders.
policy.videoHint: Stored as sent, poster frame made
policy.voiceHint: Recorded in the browser, stored as Opus
policy.tooLarge: Above this install's upload limit of {{limit}} MB.
policy.badSize: Enter a whole number of MB, 1 or more.
policy.badTypes: Enter MIME types like image/png, separated by commas.
policy.perMessageHint: Uploads are checked by their content, not their name. Anything else is refused before it is stored.
policy.badPerMessage: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.

access.heading: Where the widget may run
access.caption: Requests from any other site are refused: the config, the visitor sign-in and the live connection.
access.badOrigin: Enter an origin only: scheme and host, like https://shop.helpdock.com. No path.
access.originsHint: With no origins the widget loads nowhere. Visitors are also throttled per visitor and per IP address.
access.captcha: Check for bots before the first message
access.captchaHint: Visitors pass one challenge per conversation. The provider's script is loaded only while this is on.

low.label: Low
low.hint: About half a second on a mid-range phone. Stops naive floods.

medium.label: Medium
medium.hint: About two seconds on the same phone. Use it while you are being flooded.

access.builtInNotice: The built-in check sends nothing to anyone: the visitor's browser does a little work that is cheap for one person and expensive for a bot. It slows simple floods; it does not stop a determined attacker. Choose Turnstile for stronger bot detection.

tradeOff.turnstile: Turnstile sends visitor signals to Cloudflare and may challenge visitors on VPNs more often.
tradeOff.hcaptcha: hCaptcha sends visitor signals to hCaptcha and may show visitors a puzzle more often.

access.secretSaved: Saved {{date}} by {{name}}. The web form uses the same keys.
access.secretSavedBySystem: Saved {{date}}. The web form uses the same keys.
access.noSecret: No secret saved yet. The web form uses the same keys.
access.needsKeys: Enter a site key and a secret key to switch the check on.

signed.caption: Your site vouches for a signed-in user, so they keep their widget conversations across devices.
signed.enabled: Accept signed identity from your site
signed.enabledHint: Your server signs the user id and a timestamp with this secret (HMAC-SHA256). Signatures older than 5 minutes are refused. A bad signature leaves the visitor anonymous and is logged.
signed.secretCreated: Created {{date}} by {{name}}. Replacing it stops signatures made with the old one at once.
signed.secretCreatedBySystem: Created {{date}}. Replacing it stops signatures made with the old one at once.
signed.noSecret: No signing secret yet. Replace makes one.
signed.copyNow: Copy it now and put it on your server. It will not be shown again.
signed.allChannels: Signed-in visitors also see their email and Telegram tickets
signed.allChannelsHint: Off by default. When off, a verified visitor sees only their widget conversations.
signed.guide: How to sign: widget protocol guide

hosted.heading: Hosted form
hosted.caption: A page where customers write to you without chat. Each submission opens a ticket.

address.label: Public address
address.hint: On the help center's domain from Brand › Domains, or on this install's address until the brand has one. To put a form inside your own page, use the widget in Contact form mode.

fields.heading: Fields
fields.reorderHint: Use the up and down arrow keys to move a field.
fields.note: Shown fields appear in this order. Custom fields come from Inbox › Custom fields, and answers are saved on the ticket. An email typed here is not verified.

after.heading: After it is sent
after.caption: Where the ticket goes and what the customer reads.

department.label: Opens tickets in
department.hint: That department's agents, rules and SLA policy apply.

captcha.label: Check for bots before sending
captcha.hint: The check chosen on the Widget tab: the built-in one, Turnstile or hCaptcha. A failed check creates nothing.
captcha.missingKeys: Turnstile or hCaptcha is chosen on the Widget tab without its keys. While this is on, the form takes no messages.

thankYou.hint: {{placeholder}} becomes the reference, like {{sample}}. The page is shown in the customer's language.

telegram.caption_one: {{count}} bot · each chat with a bot is one contact; new messages open tickets in the bot’s department
telegram.caption_other: {{count}} bots · each chat with a bot is one contact; new messages open tickets in the bot’s department

empty.heading: No Telegram bots yet
empty.body: Connect a bot and every chat with it becomes a contact, with its messages as tickets.

updates.heading: How updates arrive
updates.body: In production Telegram posts each update to Helpdock’s webhook and signs it with a secret token; requests without it are refused. Development installs poll with long polling instead, so no webhook is set and the Webhook column reads “Polling”.

legend.heading: Health
legend.healthy: Healthy: the last update arrived and was filed.
legend.failing: Failing: Telegram’s last delivery failed, or the token was revoked.
legend.waiting: Waiting: saved, no update received yet.

add.title: Add a Telegram bot
add.intro: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then paste the token it gives you.
add.tokenHint: Looks like 123456789:AA… · Encrypted on save and never shown again.
add.refused: Telegram refused this token ({{detail}}). Copy it again from @BotFather.
add.unreachable: Telegram could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
add.malformed: That is not a BotFather token. It looks like 123456789:AA…
add.testFirst: Add bot stays off until Test succeeds.
add.footnote: Adding sets the webhook straight away in production. The welcome and language buttons start from the defaults; change them on the bot’s page.

refusal.token-invalid: Telegram refused this token. Copy it again from @BotFather.
refusal.telegram-unreachable: Telegram could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
refusal.bot-taken: That bot is already connected to a brand on this install.
refusal.token-other-bot: That token belongs to a different bot. Add it as a new bot instead.
refusal.department-not-found: That department no longer exists. Pick another.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete @{{username}}?
deleteConfirm.body: Helpdock removes the webhook and erases the token. Tickets from this bot stay in {{department}}, but replies to them can no longer reach Telegram. The bot itself stays in Telegram; delete it there with @BotFather.

notFound.heading: This bot is gone
notFound.body: It was deleted, or it belongs to another brand.

connection.heading: Connection
connection.caption: The token from @BotFather. Helpdock encrypts it and never shows it again.
connection.saved: Saved {{date}} by {{name}}. Stored encrypted; only the last four characters are shown, so you can tell tokens apart. Replace opens an empty field.
connection.savedBySomeone: Saved {{date}}. Stored encrypted; only the last four characters are shown, so you can tell tokens apart. Replace opens an empty field.
connection.testHint: Calls getMe with the saved token. Nothing is sent to any chat.

webhook.heading: Webhook
webhook.caption: Where Telegram sends updates for this bot.
webhook.secretBody: Generated by Helpdock when the bot was added; Telegram sends it with every update. Never shown.
webhook.hint: Calls setWebhook with this address and the bot’s secret token. Run it again after changing the public address of this install.
webhook.pollingNote: Development installs use long polling: the worker calls getUpdates and Set webhook is off. Telegram allows only one of the two per bot at a time.

routing.heading: Routing
routing.caption: Messages to this bot open tickets here.
routing.hint: Agents reply from the ticket; replies go back to the same chat.

welcome.heading: Welcome and language
welcome.caption: What the bot says when someone sends /start.
welcome.languagePick: Ask for a language, then send a welcome
welcome.promptHint: Sent first, with two buttons: English and العربية. The choice becomes the contact’s language. Shown in both languages because the language is not known yet. Leave it empty to send the default.
welcome.hint: Sent in the contact’s language. Leave one empty to send the default welcome in that language. Plain text, up to {{max}} characters.

footer.note: Changes apply to the next /start; chats already going keep their language.

danger.heading: Delete bot
danger.body: Removes the webhook and erases the token. Tickets from this bot stay, but agents can no longer reply into their chats.

meta.heading: Connected accounts
meta.caption_one: {{count}} account · each customer who writes is one contact; a new message opens a ticket in the account’s department
meta.caption_other: {{count}} accounts · each customer who writes is one contact; a new message opens a ticket in the account’s department

empty.heading: No Meta accounts yet
empty.body: Connect a WhatsApp number, a Facebook Page or an Instagram account, and everyone who writes to it becomes a contact, with their messages as tickets.
empty.blocked: An install admin has to set the Meta app secret first, and make the verify token on the Meta app card.

arrive.heading: How messages arrive
arrive.body: Meta posts every message for every account to this install’s one callback URL and signs it with the app secret; a request without a valid signature is refused. Helpdock files the text at once and fetches photos, voice notes and files in the background. An account answers for one brand only. Messenger and Instagram stop posting to an app whose address fails for an hour: Helpdock checks each subscription every hour and renews it, but the messages of the gap are not fetched again.

legend.heading: Health
legend.healthy: Healthy: the token works and Meta sends this account’s messages to Helpdock.
legend.expiring: Expiring: an Instagram token Helpdock could not renew; it stops on the date shown.
legend.failing: Failing: the token expired or was revoked, or the subscription could not be renewed.
legend.waiting: Waiting: connected, no message received yet.
legend.note: Checked every hour by the health job; “Fix” opens the account’s page.

app.heading: Meta app
app.caption: One developer app for the whole install. Every number, Page and account below uses its callback URL and its secrets.

callback.label: Callback URL
callback.hint: Paste it under Webhooks for each product in the Meta dashboard. One address serves every brand on this install.

appId.label: App id
appId.hint: From App settings › Basic in the Meta dashboard. An install setting: `HD_META_APP_ID`.

graphVersion.label: Graph API version
graphVersion.hint: Every call to Meta names it. An install setting: `META_GRAPH_VERSION`. The operations guide says how to move to the next version.

verify.label: Verify token
verify.hint: Meta sends it back once, when you save the callback URL. Replace makes a new one and shows it once.
verify.hintNone: Make one, paste it in the Meta dashboard beside the callback URL, and Meta checks it when you save.

confirm.title: Replace the verify token?
confirm.body: Helpdock makes a new token and shows it once. Messages keep arriving: Meta only uses the token when the callback URL is saved, so paste the new one there next time you save it.

reveal.title: Copy the verify token
reveal.warning: Helpdock stores it encrypted and cannot show it again. Paste it in the dashboard now.
reveal.label: Verify token
reveal.where: Meta dashboard › Webhooks for WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram, beside the callback URL.
reveal.then: Press Verify and save there. Meta calls the callback URL once with this token.
reveal.meanwhile: Messages keep arriving: Meta only uses the token when the callback URL is saved.

secret.label: App secret
secret.hint: An install setting, never shown here: `HD_META_APP_SECRET`. Meta signs every webhook with it.

instagramSecret.label: Instagram app secret
instagramSecret.hint: Instagram may sign its webhooks with this one; Helpdock checks both secrets. An install setting, never shown here: `HD_META_INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET`. Leave it out when Instagram uses the app secret.

app.footer: The app id and both secrets are install settings, set with `HD_META_APP_ID`, `HD_META_APP_SECRET` and `HD_META_INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET` in the environment, which locks them here. Which webhook fields to subscribe for each product is in the Meta channels guide.
app.loadFailed: The Meta app could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

connect.title: Connect a Meta account
connect.intro: Paste an id and a token from your Meta app’s dashboard. Helpdock checks them with Meta before it saves anything.

platformHint.whatsapp: A business number on the Cloud API. Meta may charge for each reply it delivers.
platformHint.messenger: A Facebook Page. The public can write once App Review approves your app.
platformHint.instagram: A professional account, through Instagram Login. Also needs App Review.

idHint.whatsapp: Under WhatsApp › API Setup in your app. Not the phone number itself.
idHint.messenger: Under Messenger › Messenger API settings, beside the Page’s name.
idHint.instagram: Under Instagram › API setup with Instagram login, beside the account’s username.

connect.departmentHint: New conversations open tickets here; a customer’s next message continues their open ticket.

tokenHint.whatsapp: A system-user token with `whatsapp_business_messaging` and `whatsapp_business_management`; it does not expire. Encrypted on save and never shown again.
tokenHint.messenger: A Page access token with `pages_messaging` and `pages_manage_metadata`; it does not expire. Encrypted on save and never shown again.
tokenHint.instagram: An Instagram user token. It lasts 60 days; Helpdock renews it once it is a week old. Encrypted on save and never shown again.

connect.refused: Meta refused this token: “{{detail}}”. Generate a new token for this account in the dashboard and paste it again.
connect.refusedBare: Meta refused this token. Generate a new token for this account in the dashboard and paste it again.
connect.unreachable: Meta could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
connect.malformedId: That is not an id from Meta. It is digits only.
connect.malformedToken: That does not look like a token from Meta. It has no spaces and is at least {{min}} characters.

appReview.messenger: Until Meta approves your app for `pages_messaging`, only people with a role on the app can message this Page; for them everything works as it will for customers. The Meta channels guide walks through the review.
appReview.instagram: Until Meta approves your app for `instagram_business_manage_messages`, only people with a role on the app can message this account; for them everything works as it will for customers. Messenger needs `pages_messaging` the same way. The Meta channels guide walks through the review.

connect.testFirst: Connect stays off until Test succeeds. Changing the platform clears the id and the token.
connect.footnote: Connect saves the account and subscribes the Meta app to its messages, so they start arriving at once. Recorded in the audit log.

refusal.token-invalid: Meta refused this token. Generate a new one for this account in the dashboard.
refusal.graph-unreachable: Meta could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
refusal.account-taken: This account is already connected on this install. An account answers for one brand only; disconnect it there first.
refusal.token-other-account: That token belongs to a different account, or does not reach this one. Connect that account on its own, or for WhatsApp check that its business account is assigned to the system user.
refusal.department-not-found: That department no longer exists. Pick another.
refusal.app-not-configured: This install has no Meta app set up yet. An install admin sets the app id and secrets first.
refusal.platform-mismatch: That token is for a different Meta product than the platform you chose. Pick the matching platform or paste the matching token.
refusal.reply-window-closed: The reply window has closed. A reply can be written once the customer writes again.
refusal.subscribe-failed: Meta refused to subscribe the app to this account. Check the token’s permissions and the app’s webhook settings, then connect again.

notFound.heading: This account is gone
notFound.body: It was disconnected, or it belongs to another brand.

connection.heading: Connection

caption.whatsapp: The system-user token from your Meta business settings. Helpdock encrypts it and never shows it again.
caption.messenger: The Page access token from Messenger › Messenger API settings. Helpdock encrypts it and never shows it again.
caption.instagram: The Instagram user token from Instagram › API setup with Instagram login. Helpdock encrypts it and never shows it again.

connection.saved: Saved {{date}} by {{name}}. Only the last four characters are kept in the clear, so you can tell tokens apart. Replace opens an empty field.
connection.savedBySomeone: Saved {{date}}. Only the last four characters are kept in the clear, so you can tell tokens apart. Replace opens an empty field.

testHint.whatsapp: Reads the number from Meta with the saved token. Nothing is sent.
testHint.messenger: Asks Meta who the token belongs to. Nothing is sent to anyone.
testHint.instagram: Asks Meta who the token belongs to. Nothing is sent to anyone.

connection.expiredBody: and replies cannot be sent until you reconnect.
connection.reconnectHint: Reconnect asks for a new token and keeps the account’s tickets, contacts and settings.

subscription.heading: Subscription
subscription.caption: Whether Meta posts this account’s messages to Helpdock. Checked every hour and renewed when Meta drops it.
subscription.hint: Subscribes the Meta app to this account again. Helpdock does the same on its own every hour.

number.heading: Number
number.caption: What Meta reports about this WhatsApp number. WhatsApp only.
number.charge: Each message it delivers is billed to the WhatsApp Business account: a reply cut into parts is one message per part, and every attachment is one more. The composer shows the count before you send.
number.noHuman: A reply is accepted for 24 hours after the customer’s last message. After that only an approved message template reaches them.

routing.heading: Routing

caption.whatsapp: Messages to this number open tickets here.
caption.messenger: Messages to this Page open tickets here.
caption.instagram: Messages to this account open tickets here.

routing.hint: Agents reply from the ticket; replies go back to the same conversation. The department applies from the next new conversation.

humanAgent.heading: Human Agent
humanAgent.caption: How long a person may answer after the customer’s last message.
humanAgent.label: Messenger and Instagram only
humanAgent.switch: Allow a person to reply for 7 days instead of 24 hours
humanAgent.body: Turn this on only once Meta has approved the Human Agent feature for your app. Helpdock cannot check it: turning it on says that Meta did. A person’s reply sent after 24 hours, and within 7 days of the customer’s last message, carries Meta’s `HUMAN_AGENT` tag.
humanAgent.personOnly: Only a person’s reply gets the 7 days. AI replies, rule replies and surveys keep the 24-hour window.
humanAgent.restricted: Meta may restrict a Page that uses the tag without approval. Changes are recorded in the audit log.

footer.note: Routing and Human Agent apply from the next message and the next reply.
footer.noteWhatsapp: The department applies from the next new conversation.

body.whatsapp: Erases the token and stops replies. Tickets and contacts stay. Remove the app from the number in Meta to stop its messages; until then Helpdock drops them.
body.messenger: Erases the token and stops replies. Tickets and contacts stay. Remove the app from the Page in Meta to stop its messages; until then Helpdock drops them.
body.instagram: Erases the token and stops replies. Tickets and contacts stay. Remove the app from the account in Meta to stop its messages; until then Helpdock drops them.

disconnectConfirm.title: Disconnect {{name}} from {{platform}}?

body.whatsapp: Helpdock erases the token and stops sending replies. The open tickets from this number stay in {{department}}, but replies to them can no longer reach WhatsApp. Remove the app from the number in Meta; until then its messages are dropped.
body.messenger: Helpdock erases the token and stops sending replies. The open tickets from this Page stay in {{department}}, but replies to them can no longer reach Messenger. Remove the app from the Page in Meta; until then its messages are dropped.
body.instagram: Helpdock erases the token and stops sending replies. The open tickets from this account stay in {{department}}, but replies to them can no longer reach Instagram. Remove the app from the account in Meta; until then its messages are dropped.

typeLabel.whatsapp: Type the phone number id {{id}} to confirm
typeLabel.messenger: Type the Page id {{id}} to confirm
typeLabel.instagram: Type the Instagram account id {{id}} to confirm

disconnectConfirm.footnote: The button turns solid red once the id matches exactly. Recorded in the audit log.

reconnect.title: Reconnect {{name}}

intro.whatsapp: Paste a new token for this number. Its tickets, contacts and settings stay as they are.
intro.messenger: Paste a new token for this Page. Its tickets, contacts and settings stay as they are.
intro.instagram: Paste a new token for this Instagram account. Its tickets, contacts and settings stay as they are.

tokenHint.whatsapp: Generate it in your Meta business settings. Encrypted on save and never shown again.
tokenHint.messenger: Generate it under Messenger › Messenger API settings. Encrypted on save and never shown again.
tokenHint.instagram: Generate it under Instagram › API setup with Instagram login. Encrypted on save and never shown again.

reconnect.footnote: Reconnect stays off until Test succeeds.
reconnect.footnoteInstagram: Reconnect stays off until Test succeeds. Helpdock renews the token once it is a week old.
